title: large language models for mental health diagnosis and treatment: a survey
core_idea: A systematic survey of how large language models can be applied to mental health to process complex textual data, identify behavioral patterns, support early detection, enable personalized interventions, improve public education, and address implementation challenges such as model bias, privacy protection, and clinical validation.
tldr: This review examines the potential of large language models to assist diagnosis, personalize treatment, and broaden access to mental health resources, while outlining key technical and ethical challenges for safe and effective deployment.
